decisions.q: Expense recognition for invoices: by accrual (expensePeriod) or by payment date?
decisions.impact: which month an invoice hits P&L/budget/profit

decisions.q: Is a client refund a revenue reduction or a separate expense?
decisions.current: separate expense (category 'refunds'), NOT a revenue reduction

decisions.q: What exactly is 'profit'? (Sale+SalesReport basis vs OFD basis; payroll included?)
decisions.current: two definitions; payroll NOT included in any profit reader

decisions.q: What is 'budget fact'? approval-committed or paid-realized; include v2 verified expenses?
decisions.current: 3 definitions; fact-report is paid-only+confirmed-only, drops v2 verified
salaryBudgetIncludesTaxes flag, default OFF; no tax model

decisions.q: Who is the payer for shared payroll / a shared employee across clubs?
How is a regional director's cost allocated across clubs?
decisions.current: regional payment expense filed to source club; employeeId may hold a payroll-row id (DATA-010)

decisions.q: How is regional-held cash accounted (передача регионалу / возврат)?
decisions.current: CashRegionalTransfer reduces ИП only when confirmed; return is out-of-band «Иное»

decisions.q: Which cash contour is the OFFICIAL one? (A wallet vs B fact)
decisions.current: B is canonical in readers; A still written, never reconciled

decisions.q: How are internal transfers (ООО→ИП, opening balance) reflected — never income, correct?
decisions.current: correct: not in profit; but written to both contours

decisions.q: May a refund be paid from an ИП different from the original sale's legal entity?
decisions.current: legalEntity chosen at payment, validated to the club, not to the original sale

decisions.q: What is the 'fact date' of an expense — accrual, approval, or payment?
decisions.current: mixed: expense by expenseDate, invoice by expensePeriod, refund by paidAt

decisions.q: Is VAT/НДС tracked separately, and is there a УСН/tax-liability model?
decisions.current: NO tax model — VAT folded into invoice total; 'taxes' is just an expense category

decisions.q: Should manual Sale/SalesReport revenue and OFD revenue ever coexist (double-count risk)?
decisions.current: manual sales disabled; Sale+SalesReport still feed analytics revenue — verify no overlap with OFD
